This retry tried, before falling back to Tier 3: (1) curl_cffi TLS-impersonation brute-force across 24 profiles (chrome99-131 incl. android, edge99/101, safari15_3-18_0 incl. iOS variants, firefox133) against robots.txt and the homepage - all 24 returned the same Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' managed-challenge HTML with HTTP 403; (2) r.jina.ai reader proxy against both URLs - relayed the same Cloudflare challenge page (HTTP 403 on the homepage, HTTP 200-wrapping-a-challenge on robots.txt); (3) translate.goog with two target languages (ar, fr) - same challenge page, HTTP 403; (4) WebFetch tool directly - HTTP 403 with no body; (5) Googlebot/Bingbot UA via plain curl and via curl_cffi (4 TLS profiles x 3 URLs: robots.txt, homepage, sitemap.xml) - all 403/challenge; (6) sitemap.xml / sitemap_index.xml directly - also behind the same challenge under plain UA. Tier 2 (Playwright, real installed Chrome channel, headed, anti-automation flags, realistic UA/viewport/locale) - 45s of polling, title stayed 'Just a moment...' the entire time, content length stuck at ~28.7KB, identical to the original attempt. Discovery: fetched the site's own ae/en category sitemap (https://www.homeboxstores.com/ae/en/sitemap_categories.xml, 530 category URLs) via in-page fetch() and keyword-filtered it for the full holiday vocabulary (Christmas/Xmas, Eid, Ramadan, Diwali/Deepavali, Halloween, Valentine, Easter, Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi, National Day, Festive/Festival, Seasonal, Holiday) - exactly ONE genuine seasonal category node was present: hbxdecorandfurnishings-homeaccessories-christmasdecor (redirects to canonical https://www.homeboxstores.com/ae/en/c/hbxhomeware-homedecor-christmasdecor, breadcrumb Home > Homeware > Home Decor > Christmas Decor). No Eid, Ramadan, Diwali, Halloween, Valentine's, Easter, Thanksgiving, or New Year category exists in the site's own taxonomy despite this being a UAE/GCC retailer - checked and genuinely absent, not an oversight (a homepage full-text scan's only 'eid' hit was a false-positive substring inside base64-encoded 'AED' currency tokens, not a real Eid reference). Internal site search was NOT used as absence evidence per the shared false-absence rule: a nonsense-query search (q=zzzznonsensequery123) returned 11 unrelated bedroom/mattress products instead of zero results, proving the search endpoint returns non-discriminating fallback results rather than true filtered matches, so a 'christmas' search's 111 results (mostly unrelated ceramic/decor items) could not be trusted as evidence either way - the sitemap + navigation + direct PLP verification was used instead, which is authoritative. Verified Christmas Decor is a genuine PLP, not a marketing page: real breadcrumb trail, product grid, exact site-reported count '5 products out of 5', and all 5 listed products are genuinely Christmas-themed (Shiny Star Tree Topper, Flannel Dress Santa Claus, Chamdol Tree Garland, Wreath, X-mas Reindeer Tree Skirt). Single flat leaf category, not a parent with children - the site does not split Christmas Decor into Christmas Lighting/Tableware/etc. sub-nodes, so one row only.
